description: This file declares functions and data structures related to 'delta islands' within a version control system, likely part of a delta compression or repository management module.

methods.name: island_delta_cmp
methods.description: Compare two object IDs to determine their delta island ordering.

methods.name: in_same_island
methods.description: Check if two object IDs belong to the same delta island.

methods.name: resolve_tree_islands
methods.description: Resolve delta islands within the repository's commit tree, possibly updating pack data.

methods.name: load_delta_islands
methods.description: Load delta island information into the repository context.

methods.name: propagate_island_marks
methods.description: Mark or propagate island status through commits in the repository.

methods.name: compute_pack_layers
methods.description: Calculate layering information for packing data.

methods.name: free_island_marks
methods.description: Free or reset island mark data used during processing.
